title: Gentle Office: agents at work
brief: 32-bit (GBA/SNES-like) pixel-art office for gentle-shell in the gentle-shell Gentleman-Cute theme palette (plum background, pink accents, champagne headings): 24px tiles, 16x24 sprites with outlines and 3-tone shading, role-specific agents (explorer, workers, verifier), an orchestrator with top hat, mustache and monocle, and visiting review inspectors and judgment-day judges. Each agent has a desk and a computer; the orchestrator plans at the whiteboard or walks the floor; the team meets at a table; consumed tokens are a coffee pot that drains as agents drink coffee.

artboards.title: Overworld HQ
artboards.tradeoff: Whole office at once plus a dashboard sidebar (brew, team, log); most informative, but it needs a full window

artboards.title: Dock pane
artboards.tradeoff: Narrow pane that lives beside the terminal with a Game Boy text box; always visible, but less detail and no history

artboards.title: Story mode
artboards.tradeoff: Close-up camera, HP-style brew bar and Pokemon dialog narrating each event; the most charming, but you see one thing at a time
